fixtures.env: Jade E0 solo vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 131402 'Acquisition Surety' finds no ally to carry the Debt and refunds its SP, Basic 131401 'Lash of Riches', Ultimate 131403 'Vow of the Deep'; with no Debt Collector no Charge engine output reaches 8, so the Talent FUA and Acquisition Surety Additional hits never fire

Jade E0 with Sushang (kitId sushang) vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite (level 95, 240 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 131402 makes Sushang the Debt Collector (+30 SPD), Sushang's attacks feed Jade Charge (131404, threshold 8), the Talent FUA 'Fang of Flare Flaying' fires once unenhanced and twice enhanced after the Ultimate (131403 grants 2 enhancements), Acquisition Surety Additional hits join every Debt Collector attack

requirements.claim: Skill 'Acquisition Surety' (characters.json 131402) is cast as a skill action; solo it never finds a Debt Collector target, so decide() keeps returning Skill every turn (erudition.ts:928-930, 961-966) — 7 casts in 3 cycles.
Exactly one Skill cast in the team battle: after Sushang becomes the Debt Collector decide() switches Jade to Basic for the rest of the Debt duration (erudition.ts:928).
Basic 131401 'Lash of Riches' is cast as a basic action whenever a Debt Collector exists (erudition.ts:928) — 5 casts in 3 cycles.
Each Basic is a Blast hit: one main-target hit 'Lash of Riches' per cast (erudition.ts:975-977 sim.hitBlast main) — 5 casts => 5 main hits.
The Basic also hits the 2 adjacent enemies per cast with label 'Lash of Riches (adj)' (erudition.ts:977) — 5 casts x 2 adjacent = 10 hits.
Ultimate 131403 'Vow of the Deep' fires once per battle in both fixtures (Energy 140, solo fills only from being hit, team from Skill+Basic+hits).
The Ultimate is an AoE hit against all 3 enemies with label 'Vow of the Deep' (erudition.ts:940 sim.hitAoe) — 1 cast x 3 enemies = 3 hits in both fixtures.

Talent 131404 'Fang of Flare Flaying' is an AoE FUA split into 5 hits per enemy [0.15 x4, 0.4] (erudition.ts:807-809); the first Charge-8 trigger happens before the Ultimate, so it lands unenhanced: 1 trigger x 3 enemies x 5 hits = 15.

The Ultimate grants exactly 2 Talent FUA enhancements (characters.json 131403, 'enhancement can take effect #2 time(s)'; erudition.ts:941 rt.enh = 2), so the 2 triggers after the Ultimate use label 'Fang of Flare Flaying (Enhanced)': 2 x 3 x 5 = 30 hits.

After each Debt Collector attack Jade deals Acquisition Surety Additional DMG to every living enemy (characters.json 131402; erudition.ts:914-918): 4 collector attacks while Debt is active x 3 enemies = 12 hits.

Solo negative: with no Debt Collector no per-attack Charge accrues toward the 8-Charge threshold (erudition.ts:760 CHARGE_NEED = 8, 889-901 gate requires collector), so Jade never launches a Follow-Up ATK in the solo battle.

Solo negative: Acquisition Surety Additional DMG fires only after a Debt Collector attacks (erudition.ts:884-897 early-returns without a collector), so no 'Acquisition Surety (Additional)' hits exist solo.
Solo negative: Skill 131402 never designates a Debt Collector solo (erudition.ts:953-966 — no valid ally, SP refunded instead of setDebt), so no Debt Collector lifecycle notes appear.
Ultimate payment books ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost' with amount 140 = full Energy pool (energyMax 140, erudition.ts:861, cost booked before kit body runs, erudition.ts:939).
The Ultimate cast grants the generic castUlt +5 Energy refund after the cost is paid (AGENTS: '+5 Energy (из castUlt)'; observed post-cost ENERGY_GAIN n=5 in both fixtures).
Casting the Skill with a valid Debt Collector target grants 30 Energy (erudition.ts:963 sim.gainEnergy(u, 30)); the first Jade Energy event of the team battle is n=30 (70 -> 100).
Solo negative: with no Debt Collector target the Skill takes the refund branch and grants no Energy (erudition.ts:961-966) — Jade never sees an n=30 Energy gain solo.
Basic 131401 grants +20 Energy (erudition.ts:972 sim.gainEnergy(u, 20)).
Solo every Skill spends 1 SP then refunds 1 SP because no Debt Collector target exists (erudition.ts:950 sim.spendSp(1), 965 sim.gainSp(1)) — 7 casts => 7 SP_GAIN events.
The Debt Collector gains +30 flat SPD from Acquisition Surety (characters.json 131402 'increases their SPD by #1[i]'; erudition.ts:838 mods spdFlat 30 on jade_debt_spd).

Trace A2 Reverse Repo gives +1 Pawned Asset per enemy entering combat (erudition.ts:867-869 onWaveStart) — 3 enemies => stacks 3 at battle start; jade_pawn critDmg = talent_a2 2.4%/stack x 3 = 0.072 (erudition.ts:774).

Final jade_pawn stack count = 27: 3 from wave entry (A2 pt1) + 3 x 3 from Debt Collector turn starts (A2 pt2, erudition.ts:885) + 3 x 5 from the three Talent FUAs (erudition.ts:812); A6 Asset Forfeiture adds 0.5% ATK per stack (erudition.ts:776) => atkPct = 0.005 x 27 = 0.135.
Trace A4 Collateral Ticket action-advances Jade by 50% at battle start (erudition.ts:863-865 onStart sim.advance(u, 0.5)) — pct 0.5 in both fixtures.
The Skill action resolves first, then setDebt emits 'becomes the Debt Collector' (erudition.ts:950 cast, 835 log after rt.debt assignment).

Acquisition Surety Additional hits can only follow Debt assignment: 'becomes the Debt Collector' at the Skill (T1) precedes the first 'Acquisition Surety (Additional)' hit after Sushang's first collector attack (T2).
Debt Collector lifecycle is ordered: assignment note first, removal note when rt.debt decrements to 0 at Jade's 3rd subsequent turn start (erudition.ts:871-877, 844-856).
Enhanced FUA hits require rt.enh set by the Ultimate (erudition.ts:941), so 'Vow of the Deep' resolves before the first 'Fang of Flare Flaying (Enhanced)' hit.

The Skill designates a Debt Collector exactly once: setDebt note 'becomes the Debt Collector' (erudition.ts:835) fires 1 time (a second Skill while Debt is active is blocked by decide/guard, erudition.ts:928, 951).
Debt lasts 3 Jade turns then clears: onTurnStart decrements rt.debt from 3 (erudition.ts:834) and clearDebt emits 'Jade: Debt Collector removed' (erudition.ts:844-856) exactly once.
Trace A2 pt2: each Debt Collector turn start grants Jade +3 Pawned Asset with note 'Debt Collector turn -> Jade +3 Pawned Asset' (erudition.ts:880-887); Sushang acts 3 times while Debt is active.

Every Debt Collector attack feeds Jade Charge with note 'Debt Collector attack -> Jade +N Charge' (erudition.ts:903-912): 4 collector attacks happen while Debt is active (2 skills, the Ultimate, the extra turn).
